attempts.raw_response: The first video, directed by Jonas Åkerlund, features the band performing in a dark, industrial setting with stark lighting that emphasizes their intense energy. It intercuts these performance shots with surreal, abstract imagery involving shattered glass and rapid-fire editing techniques. The second clip takes a more narrative approach, following a lone figure wandering through an empty cityscape at night, reflecting themes of isolation and longing. Both videos received heavy rotation on music channels like MTV and VH1, helping to solidify the track’s popularity across Europe. Critics praised the visual creativity, noting how the distinct styles complemented the song’s emotional depth and rhythmic drive, further enhancing its appeal to international audiences.
